FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Geopolitical Tensions and Technical Breakdown Point to Further Yen Strength
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades below its 20-day moving average at 157.93, signaling bearish momentum.
Escalating Middle East geopolitical risks and soaring oil prices bolster safe-haven demand for the Japanese Yen.
RSI at 40.36 indicates room for further downside before reaching oversold conditions.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY faces downward pressure as geopolitical risks boost JPY safe-haven appeal and technicals turn bearish.
FX.comment: Technical breakdown below the 20-day MA combined with safe-haven flows into the JPY suggests further downside momentum.
